name: Nullframe Quickshift Extraction Rig
description: A runner's emergency rig — built for jobs that go wrong fast and require a complete visual shift within thirty seconds. The outer layer is a structured hooded overjacket in dark moss green with a slightly oversized silhouette, every panel attached with rapid-release magnetic snap clusters rather than sewn seams. The entire jacket can be stripped and compacted to a palm-sized bundle in under fifteen seconds, revealing a second complete outer layer beneath: a slim-fit dark terracotta long-sleeve utility shirt with a standing collar, chest pockets, and elbow-reinforced sleeves — an entirely different silhouette, color, and read. Both layers carry scanner-resistant nano-weave in the back panels. The jacket has a full internal holster system — two chest mounts, one cross-body, and a lower-back retention point — all of which transfer cleanly to the utility shirt's hidden mounting points, which are accessed through a magnetic-sealed vent along the shirt's left flank. The trousers are a dark slate-blue modular cargo cut with detachable lower-leg panels: worn full-length they read as work trousers; panels stripped, they become knee-length shorts with a clean hem, changing the silhouette entirely. A slim neural-port cover cap in brushed pewter sits at the nape of the neck, magnetically attached and easily removed or replaced. Boots are compact mid-tops in matte dark clay with silent-sole compound and a false-bottom heel compartment for emergency storage. The whole rig is designed to let a runner walk out of a building looking nothing like the person who walked in.
functionality: Full outer jacket strips to palm-sized bundle in under 15 seconds via magnetic snap clusters; second complete visual layer revealed beneath; dual-layer scanner-resistant back panels; full internal holster system with cross-layer transfer mounting; detachable trouser lower-leg panels for silhouette change; magnetic neural-port cover; false-bottom heel compartment; complete visual identity shift without changing location
what_it_says: This outfit exists for one purpose: the job went sideways and the runner needs to not be the person who just did that. It's not a disguise kit — it's a contingency. The runner who wears this has planned for failure as carefully as they've planned for success. The terracotta utility shirt under the moss green jacket is specific enough in color to register as a different person on camera review. That's the whole point.
worn_by: runners with high job failure rates who survive anyway
operatives working jobs with a known compromise risk
anyone who has been burned before and learned from it
manufacturer: Nullframe — street label, no confirmed origin, distributed through secondary markets
story_hooks: The runner strips the outer jacket and compresses it on schedule, but the magnetic snap clusters on the left shoulder panel have degraded and one section won't release — they have to walk out of the building with half a jacket hanging off one arm and improvise the rest.

Corpsec has upgraded their camera systems to cross-reference silhouette changes in the same building within a 45-minute window — the runner's quick-change worked visually but the new system flags the trouser panel detachment as a known operative technique.
The false-bottom heel compartment contains something the runner doesn't remember putting there — and whatever it is, it's been broadcasting a low-frequency ping since before the job started.

physical_description.visual_profile: A layered extraction silhouette built for rapid transformation. The outer moss-green overjacket presents an oversized, slouched streetwear read that conceals a completely different slim utility aesthetic underneath. When stripped, reveals a sharp terracotta utility shirt with structured lines and tactical detailing. The modular trousers shift from full-length work wear to knee-shorts in seconds. Overall impression: a ghost outfit designed to shed its skin.
physical_description.fit: Outer jacket: oversized and deliberately slouched, built for concealment and rapid deployment. Inner utility shirt: slim-fit with structured shoulders and standing collar. Trousers: modular cargo cut, proportionally adjustable from full-length to cropped. All pieces are precision-engineered for clean transitions.
physical_description.primary_material: Outer jacket: treated ballistic synthetic-weave with embedded nano-weave scanner resistance. Inner shirt: high-performance stretch composite with reinforced elbow panels. Trousers: durable slate-blue modular weave with detachable panel connectors. Boots: matte clay-toned synthetic leather with proprietary silent-sole elastomer.
physical_description.texture: Outer jacket: smooth but heavily structured, with subtle grid texture from nano-weave backing. Inner shirt: smooth stretch fabric with slight sheen, tactile reinforcement at elbows. Trousers: tight weave with minimal give, industrial finish. Boots: matte, non-reflective surface with micro-traction sole pattern.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: dark moss green (jacket), dark terracotta (inner shirt), slate blue (trousers), matte pewter (neural port cap), dark clay (boots). The color palette is intentionally discordant—no visual continuity between layers to maximize recognition discontinuity.
physical_description.closures: Outer jacket: rapid-release magnetic snap clusters across all panels (15+ connection points). Inner shirt: magnetic-sealed vents along left flank for holster access. Trousers: modular mag-lock panel attachments at knees. Neural port cap: magnetic attachment at nape. Boots: traditional lacing with hidden compression lock.
distinctive_features: Rapid-release magnetic snap architecture instead of sewn seams—entire jacket strips in under 15 seconds
Dual-layer complete outfit disguise system—two entirely different silhouettes and color reads
Scanner-resistant nano-weave backing panels on both jacket and shirt
Internal and external holster mount points—transfers between jacket and shirt via hidden magnetic vent system
Modular detachable trousers legs with clean hem exposure—converts full-length to knee-shorts
Brushed pewter neural-port cover cap (mag-attached, easily swapped)
Silent-sole boot compound with false-bottom heel compartment for emergency storage
No visible brand marking—distributed through secondary markets, street provenance only
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 4-5 functional street rig. Expensive enough to indicate serious operational use, but sourced through black-market channels and street distributors. Not corporate-grade, but decidedly professional-grade extraction equipment.
physical_description.cultural_context: For runners, fixers, extraction specialists, and anyone who needs to walk out of a situation looking like someone else entirely. Signals operational training, field experience, and high-risk work. Worn by people who anticipate being remembered—and plan not to be.
physical_description.condition_typical: Usually broken-in and well-maintained, with careful attention to mag-snap alignment and nano-weave integrity. Runner gear is kept pristine at connection points but may show weathering on external surfaces. Holster mounts show consistent use wear.
